annotations.text:
PRESENT TENSE ON TOP, PAST TENSE UNDERNEATH,
AND THE MACHINE MUST PAY FOR ITS SILENCE.

Redis is authoritative for "now", Candystore for "what happened". Nothing renders
as healthy that hasn't proved it, and an empty alarm state is a claim that gets
itemized rather than left blank.

One route, not two: the attention band expands to a ranked queue when something
wants you and collapses to an auditable receipt when nothing does.

CLICK THESE

· "show a gate" on the attention band — the default is the receipt, because
  that IS the honest current state. One click shows the populated queue.

· "expand" on the 19-unknown row — the long tail is real garbage (codex
  processes sitting in deleted worktrees for 19h; `gone` will never fire
  for them because they're alive in /proc).

· on /trail: the lens chips, and "unfold tools" — watch 95.4% noise arrive.

· on /board: "show needs-attention only".

ONE LADDER REPLACES FIVE VOCABULARIES

ASM state · busy_state · HTTP status · stateBucket · ok/warning/critical.
Nothing is left unmapped — and the mapping table leads with ASM, because that is
the vocabulary actually driving / and /hq.

WHY /truth IS NOT AN ADMIN PAGE

`agent-hook-telemetry` already computes `codex|attention → {verdict: silent,
agentsAlive: 41}`. Gates on 41 live agents are undetectable, so BLOCKED is
under-counted and an empty queue is not yet a trustworthy claim. Ships with no
new backend.

REVIEW IS NOT A BAND — and three other corrections

· `in_review` occurs ZERO times. Plane's state.group has no review value. Review
  lives in `ticket.state.name` and renders as a NUDGE tag inside started/completed.
· 31 of 227 tickets carry no `tp_band` at all — shown, never silently dropped.
· `agent:working` is the only ownership signal; its age is always visible and
  cross-checked against a live worker scope.
· Never poll the 14-day ticket slice: 12.2 MB, because every event carries
  description, _html, _json, _binary and _stripped.

WHY THE PHONE IS NOT THE DESKTOP

Four tabs, not seven. `Board` was cut — nobody triages 227 tickets on a phone —
and `Trail` took the slot, because "what just happened" is the question you ask
while away from the box.

Everything tappable is ≥44px, including the unobserved row and the "more
observed" footer.

`Restart bridge` is two-step and sits AFTER `Logs`. The desktop's floating
"Restart gateways" button — one misclick from the page title, no confirm — is
exactly the pattern this replaces.

The Plane bridge card exists here and nowhere else today. It is the one thing
/hq has that the desktop does not, and the bridge is currently down.

FUTURE SEAMS — nothing here is built on data that doesn't exist

· FLUME → /fleet already speaks its vocabulary via packages/org-model. Needs a
  checkout and a contract; the repo is 6.5 months cold.
· DeLoCompany → /hq is the phone surface today; a second Mini App skins the
  shared token layer rather than forking it.
· KREBS → /board is keyed on tp_band. A `phase` column appears the day Krebs
  emits anything. Today it has zero executable code.
· DISPATCH → exactly one command is wired end to end. Cmd-K `>` prefix, not a
  console for six schemas with no consumer.
· EVENT DOMAINS → /trail reads /lenses and /classes at runtime. Build nav from
  live counts, never the schema list: 6 of 14 declared domains have never fired.

HOUSE RULES (moved off the routes — a control plane should not lecture its operator)

· A rung hue never appears on chrome, controls, filters, captions or explainers —
  only on a row, cell or badge whose severity it states.
· No rung hue appears without its glyph. BROKEN and NUDGE differ by 1.01:1 in
  luminance, so the glyph carries the meaning, not the colour.
· OK is grey. Green means one thing: left the queue in the last 6 hours.
· Confidence is form, never hue — and no confidence treatment may push text
  under 3:1.
· 10.5px for static chrome at ≥4.5:1; 11.5px minimum for anything variable.
  Density comes from leading, not from shrinking type.
· An inferred edge renders dotted, names its own derivation, and may NEVER
  drive a severity count.
